title: Implement an Effective Employee Engagement Strategy
summary:
Implement an Effective Employee Engagement Strategy fbacaj Fri, 09/18/2026 - 11:29

How to Improve Employee Engagement and Build a Strong Workplace Culture

Employee engagement is one of the biggest drivers of employee retention, workplace culture, and productivity. In this video, learn what employee engagement is, why it matters, and the practical strategies employers can use to build a more motivated workforce. Discover how onboarding, career development, employee recognition, leadership support, and workplace wellness all shape engagement, plus how to measure it and use feedback to strengthen the employee experience and reduce turnover.

Topics:

  • 0:17 – What Is Employee Engagement?
  • 0:36 – Why Is Employee Engagement Important?
  • 1:03 – How To Improve Employee Engagement
  • 1:45 – Employee Engagement Strategies in Action
  • 2:17 – Establishing and Measuring Engagement
  • 2:34 – Turn Your Strategy into Action Today With Paychex

<p id="transcript-button">View Transcript</p>

0:05 Employee engagement is the foundation of a strong and successful workplace. Engaged employees are more likely to be motivated, loyal, and invested in your organization's success. But how do you foster that kind of culture?

What Is Employee Engagement?

0:18 What is employee engagement?

0:20 Employee engagement is about fostering an emotional connection to your company's goals and values. It's the glue that keeps employees aligned with the organization while inspiring loyalty and innovation. After onboarding, engagement is an ongoing effort driven by meaningful communication, support, and collaboration.

Why Is Employee Engagement Important?

0:37 Why is employee engagement important?

0:39 Engaged employees inspire a culture of innovation and teamwork, stay committed to their roles, and reduce costly turnover.

0:47 On the flip side, disengagement—or as we've come to know it, "quiet quitting"—can strain your resources, decrease morale, and limit your business's ability to achieve long-term goals.

0:58 Addressing employee engagement is no longer optional—it's essential.

How To Improve Employee Engagement

1:04 Building engagement starts with actionable steps. Here are key strategies to implement change within your organization.

1:12 Hire the right talent by aligning your company's mission with their personal goals.

1:17 Offer a structured onboarding program that supports new hires from day one.

1:21 Create opportunities for professional growth, training, and open communication.

1:27 Use modern tools and technology to streamline work processes and boost efficiency.

1:33 From recognizing employee achievements to promoting wellness and social responsibility, these small actions create a ripple effect of positive cultural change.

Employee Engagement Strategies in Action

1:47 Successful engagement should align with your company culture and priorities.

1:50 Some strategies include:

1:52 Developing clear career paths to foster confidence in employee growth.

1:57 Building leadership teams that inspire and motivate.

2:00 Investing in wellness spaces and creative workplace design.

2:04 Giving employees purpose by connecting their work to greater business and societal outcomes.

2:09 These strategies empower teams and create workplaces where people want to thrive, not just work.

Establishing and Measuring Engagement

2:18 Measuring engagement should be an ongoing effort. Use surveys, monitor retention rates, and perform regular check-ins to gather valuable feedback.

2:26 These insights will help shape actionable plans, ensuring your strategy adapts to the evolving needs of your team.

Turn Your Strategy into Action Today With Paychex

2:35 Turn your strategy into action today with Paychex.

2:38 Driving employee engagement takes intention, but you don't have to do it alone.

2:43 Paychex offers tools that simplify onboarding, enhance communication, and empower your workforce for long-term success.

Strengthen Employee Engagement Across Your Organization

Learn how to improve employee engagement, reduce turnover, strengthen workplace culture, and create an environment where employees feel connected to organizational success.
